title: shipyard command settings
description: cli.toml for the shipyard command, on every machine that runs it. On the Mac it sits beside the config.toml the app reads; elsewhere it lives in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/shipyard/ (default ~/.config/shipyard/). Every key is optional; a missing file means the defaults. Keys are kebab-case. Unlike config.toml, an unknown key is an error: the command that reads the file fails until it's fixed.

version.description: The cli.toml format version. Only 1 exists; a file without it is version 1.

notices.description: Where this machine's shipyard notify sends a notice. With app-machine set, straight to the app on that Mac over your tailnet, at <app-scheme>://<app-machine>:<app-port>; without it, through the herdr-shipyard plugin for the Mac's poll.

app-machine.description: The Mac running the app, by its MagicDNS name alone, short or full, such as "my-mac" or "my-mac.tail1234.ts.net": no scheme and no port. None by default.

app-scheme.description: How the request travels, as tailscale serve exposes the app's port on the Mac (--http or --https).

app-port.description: The port tailscale serve exposes on the Mac.
